ValidationRule.description: A gift of money that is zero is not a transaction. Refunds and write-offs are negative, which is allowed. An in-kind gift is exempt: it is goods rather than money, so its amount is always zero and its worth is on Fair Market Value (R-G12, ADR-0029).
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A gift amount cannot be zero. Enter what was received, or enter a negative amount to record a refund. If you are recording goods or services, set Type to In-kind: an in-kind gift has no amount and its worth goes in Fair Market Value.
